verdict.rationale: Shopify's Catalog MCP servers (global and storefront) expose structured, machine-readable product data — price (minor units), availability, variants, media, checkout links (continue_url) — verified live via runtime probes (get_product, search_catalog, cart continue_url), and Cart/Checkout MCP further surface checkout links and negotiated payment handlers. Missing for 10: no independent third-party benchmark of data completeness/accuracy across many merchants beyond Shopify's own demo store.
